hooks.command: jq -re '.tool_input.query | select(test("202[0-4]"))' > /dev/null && { echo "Query contains outdated year. Current year is $(date +%Y). Fix it." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -re '.tool_input.filter | select(. == "all")' > /dev/null && { echo 'filter "all" is not allowed. Use vigilare_get_lists first, then filter by list_id.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
